newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast coffee bean exports rise in September.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast coffee bean exports rise in September.

text.p: Ivory Coast exported 18,019 tonnes of robusta coffee beans in September against 12,888 tonnes in August, official data show.
Exports in September 1995 amounted to 17,613 tonnes.
Cumulative exports in so far in the 1995/96 season were 155,169 tonnes against 134,731 tonnes in the same period of the 1994/95 season.
The season, which usually runs from October to October, has yet to be formally closed.
The 1996/97 season has been set to open in late 1996 or early 1997 but exporters say it is not clear which year applies to coffee exported between now and then.
The data showed Abidjan, the main port, handled 14,973 tonnes of last month's shipments and 3,046 tonnes left via San Pedro.
A total 1,133 tonnes of coffee product also left Abidjan but figures were not available for San Pedro. --Matthew Bunce, Abidjan Newsroom +225 21 90 90
